entities.name: Sikh Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sikh Empire, a political institution in Pakistan during Sikh Empire and British Conquest (1799–1849). Grew from Maharaja Ranjit Singh unifies the Punjab under the Sikh Empire. Led to the emergence of Second Anglo-Sikh War — Britain annexes the Punjab after the Battle of Gujrat and British annex Sindh after defeating the Talpur Mirs at the Battle of Miani.
